sheets.title: Connections › GitHub, Saved app: one press of the remove key — 1280 × 800
sheets.caption: A guest switches External connectors on and registers a GitHub App through the app's own Manifest flow (github.com form and api.github.com stood in for). Then one press of "Remove GitHub App from this device". Read from the browser.
sheets.before: window.confirm fired: "Remove the GitHub App from this device? Its private key and client secret will be deleted." (a browser dialog, not in the page; dismissed). In-page: one key, unchanged, 24×24 @598,426
sheets.after: no browser dialog; key relabelled "Confirm removing the GitHub App from this device", class is-armed, 24×24 @598,426; "Keep the GitHub App" 24×24 @622,426; focus on the armed key
